{{Quote|He would do this to the entire world. He stirs. The longer we wait - holding on by our fingernails - the more he destroys what remains. We can delay no longer.|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

==Summary==
:{{Pov|[[Nynaeve al'Meara]]}} 
Nynaeve and [[Naeff]] race to the All Summer's neighborhood in [[Tear]] where a [[Bubble of evil]] has struck. She thinks about the terrible storm to the north, where [[Lan Mandragoran|Lan]] is. Nynaeve no longer feels discomfort around the [[Asha'man]] since she helped cleanse the [[Taint]]. The madness no longer spreads within male channellers, but the scars remain. Naeff's madness causes hallucinations of [[Myrrdraal]] which he incorrectly believes is a [[Talent]].

[[Defenders of the Stone|Defenders]] circle a portion of the city appearing, "''blander than it should.  Washed out."'' Paving stones crumble to powder when walked upon. An inn of people are revealed to be lifeless husks that also crumble to powder. The bubble of evil sucked away all signs of life. The duo use flows of air to blow through the remaining buildings, searching for any survivors. They gather the powder into a pile. Nynaeve channels fire at the powder, creating a giant flash that could have torched the entire city if they hadn't gathered it together.

Frustrated at the failure to find no one alive, Nynaeve [[Delving|delves]] the Asha'man and finds the madness infecting his brain. She hypothesizes that the [[Dark One]]'s madness resembles [[Compulsion]]. It takes a lot of her energy, but Nynaeve heals Naeff's madness. With tears in his eyes, he runs to find [[Nelavaire Demasiellin|his Aes Sedai]].

The clouds break, announcing Rand's return. Nynaeve comforts people who witnessed the bubble of evil when Rand finds her. She wonders why he still wears this old coat {{ref|This is still the one he exchanged with a Tuatha'an in Ebou Dar and wore on Dragonmount during reforging.}}. Rand blames himself for this bubble saying that the longer he postpones the [[Last Battle]], the more such events will come and the stronger the Dark One will be. After debating the merits of his plan to open the [[bore]] before resealing it, Nynaeve begins to believe in the plan. She states that she must return to the [[The White Tower|Tower]], where she can try to persuade [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] of this. Rand is saddened but asks her to return to him, to at least be there when he goes to [[Shayol Ghul]]. He trusts her to be one of the duo in the circle when he uses ''[[Callandor]]'' and suggests either [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] or [[Aviendha]] as the other. She is proud of the honor Rand shows her and promises to be there. Rand warns her that the Tower could destroy her personality which is valuable. He suggests her not to become a perfect "emotionless" Aes Sedai. Then she inspects his madness, and is amazed at the ''thousands upon thousands of the tiny black thorns pricked into his brain, but beneath them was a brilliant white lacing of '''something.''''' She does not even know where to begin and admits as much to Rand. He is amazed at her ability, claiming that not even the greatest Healers of the [[Age of Legends]] could Heal diseases of the mind with the [[One Power]]. She promises to Heal the other Asha'man in Tear before reporting to the White Tower, but she doesn't commit to heading to the [[Black Tower]]. Rand agrees as he tells her that something is wrong there. Nynaeve leaves, but not before giving Rand a hug.

:{{Pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}} 
Egwene stands at the apex of the White Tower and watches the clouds return over [[Tar Valon]]. She meets with three sitters who began the hunt for the [[Black Ajah]]. They discuss plausible theories that may have allowed [[Mesaana]] to defeat the [[Oath Rod]] during the [[Great Purge]]. They also touch on her history in order to plan a way to defeat her.

==Theories==
*Rand disappears somewhere to ''fetch something.'' This could be a trip with [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] to get ''[[Callandor]]'', prior to his meeting with the [[Borderlander]]s.
*Min keeps one her visions a secret; that Rand's success against the Dark One depends upon a woman she thinks is dead- [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]]. Since [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat's]] successful rescue of the Aes Sedai, it can be assumed that she will complete the ''[[Callandor]]'' circle with Rand and Nynaeve.
